description: Codex's hook set. The .codex-plugin manifest's hooks field replaces the default hooks/hooks.json location, so this file is the whole registration: Stop (tagged for the gate's per-host continuation budget), SessionStart and PreCompact. Codex documents no PostToolUseFailure event, so the delegation-failure recording this plugin does elsewhere is absent here and the run's report is the only record of a degraded round. Each handler carries a commandWindows override, the field Codex's hooks reference documents as "an optional Windows-only command override"; without it a Windows Codex would run a POSIX shell string. Windows CI executes every commandWindows launcher with a stub script, checking one execution, deliberate exit 2, and missing-script allow. This does not verify a Windows Codex lifecycle.

hooks.command: P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT}}/skills/ultragoal/scripts/goal_stop.py"; [ -f "$P" ] || exit 0; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "$P" --host codex; else exec python "$P" --host codex; fi
hooks.commandWindows: (if not exist "%CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT%\skills\ultragoal\scripts\goal_stop.py" exit 0) & where py >nul 2>nul || exit 0 & py -3 "%CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT%\skills\ultragoal\scripts\goal_stop.py" --host codex

hooks.command: P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT}}/skills/ultragoal/scripts/goal_session_start.py"; [ -f "$P" ] || exit 0; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "$P"; else exec python "$P"; fi
hooks.commandWindows: (if not exist "%CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT%\skills\ultragoal\scripts\goal_session_start.py" exit 0) & where py >nul 2>nul || exit 0 & py -3 "%CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT%\skills\ultragoal\scripts\goal_session_start.py"

hooks.commandWindows: (if not exist "%CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT%\skills\ultragoal\scripts\goal_pre_compact.py" exit 0) & where py >nul 2>nul || exit 0 & py -3 "%CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT%\skills\ultragoal\scripts\goal_pre_compact.py"
